excluded_scope: Structural rewrites directly involving joint nodes

confirmed_fixes.issue: Per-record directory refreshes interleaved with progress repainting starved the GUI event loop during fast large batches.
confirmed_fixes.change: Coalesce progress, file-state and directory presentation at 100 ms while counting every terminal step; flush on completion, preserve cancellation text and reset it for the next run, including saved results preceding a caught error.
confirmed_fixes.regression: Two 1000-event signal-burst tests for completed and saved-before-error paths; check one progress update, cancellation text, no stale final refresh and a fresh run; real 512-pair GUI execution and 1025 saved records.

confirmed_fixes.issue: Assigning roots[child] from roots[parent] retains a QHash value reference that insertion can invalidate. AddressSanitizer detected heap-use-after-free in largeSubtreeAndLimit.
confirmed_fixes.change: Read a value copy before insertion in all three source-root index builders.
confirmed_fixes.regression: Existing 10000-node rewrite test plus a new 1024-node extension across two source roots, explicit root identity, execution, preview and undo/redo.

confirmed_fixes.issue: Non-const indexing of a shared temporary list detached and copied the entire dataset/name list for each displayed pair member.
confirmed_fixes.change: Use const at() access in catalog descriptions and member-table display.
confirmed_fixes.regression: Actual 1000/9999-pair dialog, member selection, tooltip, cancellation and identity preservation.

confirmed_fixes.issue: Same-batch unassigned-candidate limit was per joint node, allowing the batch aggregate to exceed the intended bound.
confirmed_fixes.change: Apply the 100000-candidate bound to the batch aggregate, matching cross-node planning.
confirmed_fixes.regression: 50 joint nodes / 99900 candidates accepted; 51 / 101898 rejected; reproduced as failing before the fix.

regression.counting: QtTest totals include initTestCase/cleanupTestCase and data rows. Do not add focused reruns or sanitizer counts.
regression.first_final_run: 1992 passed, 1 timing-sensitive close/restart timeout; unchanged source passed three focused reruns and the whole 50-case update target; final summary uses that target rerun.

randomized_execution.oracle: Independent affine/sine formula for every output sample; duplicate labels, reordered sources and downstream pair preview.

independent_references.scope: Numerical agreement for these cases; no new significance calibration.
